messages:
alice: Nightly eval alert: 12/240 prompt-set failures on quantized-llama-v2-7b in the 03/20 00:00 run. Fails only on the xdist-parallel workers, single-process runs pass. logs attached.
michael: Can you paste a minimal repro / failing assertion? also which pytest/xdist version?
alice: pytest 7.4.2, pytest-xdist 3.1.0. Repro is consistent with -n4, passes with -n0. failing snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: generation mismatch for prompt id 42
E   Expected tokens start: [50256, 101, 202]
E   Actual tokens start:   [50257, 101, 202]
```
carla: (sorry cross-post) :thinking_face: could be tokenizer order nondet.
sandeep: I remember a tokenizer cache change that deduped vocab with a set and wrote to a tempfile in /tmp. If multiple workers race they'll produce different orderings and then different IDs.
julia: @sandeep that would explain why single-process passes. Any idea where in code? docker images for nightly use build from main-2026-03-19.
sandeep: it's in tokenizers/loader.py: we call tempfile.gettempdir() + constant name "tok_cache.json" and use set(vocab) then list(set).order is arbitrary.
alice: repro command I used:
```
PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/evals/test_prompt_set.py::test_generation_consistency -n4 -k "quantized-llama-v2-7b" -q
```
michael: can you confirm if setting TMPDIR per-worker helps? try export TMPDIR=/tmp/worker-$PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER
alice: I tried setting TMPDIR to unique dirs per worker via export in envmatrix — still flaky because code uses tempfile.gettempdir() *before* xdist sets worker env var.
sandeep: quick local fix idea: use tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(prefix=f"tokcache-{os.getpid()}-", delete=False) or avoid set->list by sorting vocab deterministically.
julia: sorting seems simplest and lowest-risk. Also add os.getpid() in temp name if we must write to common dir.
michael: small patch snippet:
```
- entries = list(set(raw_vocab))
+ entries = sorted(set(raw_vocab))
```
and in cache path:
```
- cache_file = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "tok_cache.json")
+ cache_file = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(prefix=f"tokcache-{os.getpid()}-", delete=False).name
```
ops-bot: CI:nightly-evals (triggered) started for commit 9f4b2a2 by sandeep
sandeep: I'll open a PR with both changes + a unit test that simulates parallel workers writing caches. assigning reviewers: @julia @michael
alice: failing seed from the run: RNG_SEED=1357924680. attaching generation log (short):
```
[worker-2] seed=1357924680 prompt_id=42 start_token=50257
[worker-0] seed=1357924680 prompt_id=42 start_token=50256
```
julia: also check PYTHONHASHSEED and locale, iteration order for dicts/sets can vary across processes if hash seed differs.
michael: FYI our CI does not set PYTHONHASHSEED; good call. but even with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 the set->list will still be unsorted but deterministic per process; different processes still disagree.
sandeep: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/fix/tokenizer-cache-xdist
alice: tested PR branch locally: -n4 now passes 10/10 runs. :tada:
sandeep: merging after approvals, will monitor next nightly. thanks all.
